context: The freshness p90 of 17 days and max of 30.3 are artifacts, not staleness: three advance-preview articles about today's total solar eclipse carry source dates from 12 and 26 July, since the previews were written weeks ahead of a scheduled event. The metric also only measures the 16 of 62 articles backdated past midnight — same-day articles compute a negative age and are filtered out — so the tail is drawn from a small, self-selecting sample. Median lag of 0.6 days on that sample is the number that matters, and it is inside target.
